verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents one agent resolving issues across chat, email, voice, SMS and WhatsApp (docs-31, docs-49), and mentions Slack as a place to interact with Coach (docs-10), but this is Coach access, not evidence that the customer-facing agent itself operates in Slack or social channels. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the customer-facing support agent (not just Coach) handles Slack and social media channels, and independent/hands-on validation of omnichannel deployment.
